subtitles.en: The First Vision and the visits of Moroni

descriptions.en: Extracts from the history of Joseph Smith, canonized in the Pearl of Great Price: the First Vision of 1820, the night visits of the messenger Moroni, the recovery of the plates from the hill Cumorah, and the restoration of the Aaronic Priesthood.
